title: PDF Conversion Services Samples
description: Unbranded PDF conversion request screenshots and a PDF-to-Word/Excel quality checklist for US, UK and Australian projects.
value: Scope a PDF conversion job before production: source format, target format, page count and layout priorities.
guide: Use the screenshots to scope source format, output format, page count and layout priorities. The quality guide explains what to check against the source after conversion. These are project-planning examples, not completed conversion case studies.
